name: fi-tax-overview
description: Find the existing Finland tax skills for 2026 preparation and identify their scope and review limits. Routes individual and corporate income tax, VAT, YEL, payroll, transfer-pricing documentation, cross-border residence, prepayments, country-by-country reporting and property-transfer questions to the relevant source skill. Use when a Finland tax question needs classification before any calculation, when checking which workpaper applies, or when reconciling the country pack's partial coverage. This overview supplies no standalone tax calculation of its own or current formation fee, and the country remains a source-cited draft with source-review evidence in the pack README; professional attestation is separate.
